cashflow.title: Low point: {amount} on {date}
cashflow.scope: Today's balance and recurring transactions only, everyday spending not included.
cashflow.gap_note: This is not the end-of-period forecast shown on Today: the forecast accounts for remaining budgets, upcoming bills and expected income; the low point only uses today's balance and recurring transactions.
cashflow.bills_note: An upcoming bill with no matching recurring transaction is not in the curve, even though the calendar and the list show it.
cashflow.no_recurring: No recurring transaction: the curve stays at today's balance.
cashflow.load_error: Could not load the curve. The calendar and the list are still usable.

deadlines.title: Upcoming bills
deadlines.total: {count, plural, one {Total of the displayed due date} other {Total of the # displayed due dates}}
deadlines.others: {count, plural, one {# other not included} other {# others not included}}
deadlines.next_month_error: Next month's due dates could not be loaded.

anomalies.none_detected: No anomaly detected for this period.

analyses.title: Analysis
analyses.desc: Breakdown of spending, trends and overruns of closed periods, on a single screen.
analyses.no_closed_period: No closed period: there is nothing to analyse yet. Analysis covers finished periods.

breakdown.legend: Change = variation of the amount against the comparison period: ↗ and + if spending goes up, ↘ and − if it goes down, "New" if it was 0. For spending, red if it goes up, blue if it goes down. For savings the change stays grey: only the arrow and the sign give the direction.

evolution.empty: Evolution data is not available for the closed periods. Please try again later.
evolution.total_legend: Bars: total expenses and savings of each closed period, pending bills included.
evolution.category_title: Actual and budget of a category
evolution.category_legend: Blue bar: actual of the category; grey bar: budget. Pending bills excluded; "Overrun" marks a period where the actual exceeds the budget (same rule as the Overruns tab).
evolution.pick_category: Choose an expense or savings category to show its actual against its budget.
evolution.balance_legend: Line: reconciled bank balance at the end of each closed period.

overruns.legend: Each cell is the category's excess for the period: "—" when there is none. Pending bills are excluded and the current period is not shown. At most the last 6 closed periods.
overruns.link_hint: Selecting a category opens its transactions, all periods and pending bills included: the list can therefore exceed the amount in the table.

dashboard.welcome: Welcome to Account V2! Let us guide you through the main features.
dashboard.stats: Your forecast balance at the end of the period, your bank balance and your upcoming balance, for the chosen period.
dashboard.breakdown: Visualize at a glance your spending distribution by category compared to your budget.
dashboard.transactions: What needs your attention: anomalies, card payments to reconcile and exceeded budgets.
dashboard.add_btn: Click "New transaction" to add a transaction.
dashboard.stats_mobile: Your forecast balance at the end of the period and how far along the period you are.
dashboard.breakdown_mobile: The most used budgets, with a mark showing where you should be.
dashboard.add_btn_mobile: Tap « + » in the bottom bar to add a transaction.

account.intro: Setting up an account involves several steps to ensure accurate management.
account.name: Give your account a clear name (e.g., Checking, Savings).
account.create_btn: Click here to create a new account.
account.balance: Enter your current bank balance to start on the right foot.
account.settings: Find your categories, tags, rules and recurring items here, to set up once and for all.
account.periods: Finally, create your budget periods (month by month) to track your goals.
account.more: Under « More »: your budgets and periods, your due dates and the settings (categories, tags, rules, recurring).

transactions.description: Enter the description. Your smart rules can suggest a category automatically!
transactions.amount: The amount. Use a minus sign (-) for expenses.
transactions.pending: Check this for pre-authorizations or upcoming payments. They won't count immediately in your reconciled balance.
transactions.shortcuts: Use Shift+Tab to toggle between transaction and transfer, and Enter to save.
